FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 98
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Senator Keith Kelley
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 01/23/2026
Senate Bill 98 as introduced would increase the financial obligations of the Education Trust
Fund by an undetermined amount annually to expand benefits provided by the Alabama G. I.
Dependents’ Scholarships Program to include graduate studies in a medical field pursuant to the
provisions of this bill.
